Xech Mini Chef Multi Kettle – Smart, Portable Cooking for Modern Homes

Meet the Xech Mini Chef Multi Kettle, a compact electric cooking kettle designed for fast, safe, and versatile everyday meals. Whether you live in a hostel, travel often, or need a reliable extra appliance in your kitchen, this portable electric cooker delivers powerful performance with intelligent safety. From boiling, steaming, sautéing, and making one-pot recipes to preparing noodles, soups, rice, or even biryani, the Mini Chef is built to simplify cooking while saving time and energy.

Built with a premium ceramic-coated pot, this electric kettle cooks clean and enhances taste. Food doesn’t stick, and cleaning doesn’t demand endless scrubbing. With dual heat modes, you can switch between low and high heat just like a gas flame, giving you better control for simmering or rapid boiling. Its thoughtful 2L size makes it ideal for small families while remaining easy to pack for trips.

Safety meets convenience with a cool-touch body, auto power shutdown, and dry burn protection. Even if you forget to switch it off or accidentally run it without water, the kettle protects you and your kitchen. Add to that the ISI certified power cord, and you get peace of mind with every use.

The Mini Chef also features intelligent heat lock technology that keeps warmth where it matters, ensuring faster cooking with lower electricity consumption. A transparent glass lid lets you monitor food without releasing heat or flavours. The detachable power cord makes it perfect for compact storage, travel, office lunches, and dorm living.

Why Choose?

  • Ceramic-Coated Pot: Non-stick surface for healthier cooking, better taste, and effortless cleaning.
  • Dual Heat Modes: Choose low or high temperature for boiling, cooking, or reheating.
  • 2L Family Capacity: Spacious enough for rice or biryani, yet compact for travel.
  • Cool-Touch Body: Exterior stays safe to handle, preventing finger burns.
  • Auto Power Shutdown: Automatically switches off after cooking for added safety.
  • Intelligent Heat Lock Tech: Faster results with improved energy efficiency.
  • Stainless Steel Steamer: Prepare momos, vegetables, dumplings, or dhokla without oil.
  • ISI Certified Power Cord: Reliable electrical safety for Indian households.
  • Dry Burn Protection: Cuts power when there’s no water, avoiding damage.
  • Transparent Glass Lid: Watch food cook without lifting the cover.
  • Detachable Power Cord: Easy to unplug and carry anywhere.
  • Fast & Even Heating: Uniform temperature ensures perfectly cooked meals.
  • Compact & Portable: Ideal for hostels, PGs, offices, and small kitchens.
  • Wood-Finish Handle Design: Elegant look with a comfortable grip.

Perfect for Everyday Recipes

Use the as your go-to appliance for instant noodles, pasta, soup, oatmeal, boiled eggs, steamed vegetables, poha, upma, and much more. It works as a travel cooker, electric lunch maker, rice, and multipurpose boiler in one stylish unit. The fast and even heating system eliminates hotspots, so every bite is cooked consistently.

Students love its portability, working professionals rely on its speed, and families appreciate the safe design. Thanks to the detachable cord and compact footprint, it easily fits in backpacks, drawers, or tight counter spaces. Whether at home or on the move, enjoy quick meals without depending on a full stove setup.

Designed for Convenience & Efficiency

This energy-efficient electric cooker is engineered for modern lifestyles. Intelligent temperature control, heat retention, and automatic shutoff mean less monitoring and more freedom. The ceramic interior supports healthy, low-oil cooking while the stainless steel steamer unlocks nutritious options with full flavours. If you want a portable electric for cooking that combines safety, elegance, and performance, the is the upgrade your kitchen deserves.
